method.label: Cancel factorials and complete the square

annotationRationale: The solution simplifies factorial quotients, completes the resulting quadratic to a square, and selects the positive square root.
sourceMethod: Follows the official method of dividing by n!, expanding, and completing the square. The factorial identities and positive-root selection are made explicit.

review.mathCheck: Cancelling the nonzero factorial gives \((n+1)(n+3)=440\), hence \((n+2)^2=441\). The roots are 19 and -23; positivity selects 19, whose digit sum is 10, choice C.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA AMC 10B solution 6, page 3. It follows factorial cancellation and completing the square, adding explicit factorial identities and the positive-root justification.
review.annotationCheck: Factorial cancellation and completing the square are appropriately assessed; direct square-root solving is appropriate support. The explanation is complete for AMC 12.
